name: passkeys
title: Passkeys (WebAuthn)
description: Passwordless sign-in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello and security keys

env.description: Relying party id (your domain, e.g. example.com). Defaults to the WEB_URL host — passkeys are bound to it
Name shown by the authenticator (defaults to APP_NAME)

notes: Users add passkeys under Settings → Security; the sign-in page gets a "Sign in with a passkey" button.
WebAuthn requires HTTPS (or http://localhost). Changing the domain invalidates existing passkeys.
A user-verified passkey sign-in skips the TOTP/email-code step, since it already proves two factors.
